name: Vietnamese-Entrance-Bench
description: A benchmark of Vietnamese entrance exam questions designed to evaluate language understanding, reasoning, and domain knowledge across subjects encountered in Vietnamese school/university entrance tests. It measures model performance on answering multiple-choice and free-response questions in Vietnamese, stressing cross-disciplinary factual and problem-solving ability. Useful for assessing Vietnamese-language capability and educational knowledge coverage.
reputation: Niche dataset focused on Vietnamese exam material with modest adoption in Vietnamese NLP and education-evaluation research communities.
